title: Oven Roasted Kenyan Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Kenyan lamb stew featuring tahini and render-fat, perfect for a lazy Sunday. This dish is also anti-inflammatory-friendly and has a nice mustardy flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the rendered lamb fat over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the lamb pieces to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
In a small bowl, mix together the tahini, mustard seeds, turmeric, and black pepper.
Add the tahini mixture to the pot and stir to combine.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the stew for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
